title: YouTube Edit (Eddy)
summary: Drive a verified local Eddy engine to produce a YouTube launch kit, then optionally prepare and schedule Threadify promotional posts after explicit final approval. Inspect actual output assets; do not permit unapproved source-media transfers or publishing.
triggers: prepare an edit plan and Threadify promo posts

modes.summary: Run Eddy and return the launch kit (edited long video, Shorts, titles, thumbnails, chapters, description). No Threadify posting step.
Run Eddy, then prepare Threadify promotional post/thread candidates from the launch kit and schedule them only after explicit final approval.

free_capabilities: local Eddy edit run (raw footage to launch kit)
promotional post/thread candidate review from the launch kit

instructions: Use a verified local Eddy installation or a finished launch kit. The plugin archive excludes the engine; do not run source-checkout installation commands inside an installed skill directory. Claim only inspected assets from a completed run.
If the Eddy engine is unavailable, ask the user to provide the finished video assets, titles, and description before preparing any promo copy.
When Threadify MCP is unavailable, return exact candidate post texts, proposed schedule slots, and the local media paths for manual posting.
Do not claim Threadify generated, scheduled, or optimized posts if the connected tool was unavailable.
Keep private metrics, account IDs, member data, and private proof paths out of the fallback artifact.
Edit-only requires no Threadify connection. Upload only the exact media approved for external transfer; scheduling requires separate final approval.
Keep feedback local unless the user gives explicit opt-in to share the exact feedback with Threadify.
